CONSTRAINT listing_event listing_event_event_type_check: CHECK ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['new_listing'::text, 'price_change'::text, 'status_change'::text, 'back_on_market'::text, 'delisted'::text])))
CONSTRAINT listing_event listing_event_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
CONSTRAINT media media_listing_key_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (listing_key) REFERENCES <schema>.property(listing_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
CONSTRAINT media media_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (media_key)
CONSTRAINT media media_storage_status_check: CHECK ((storage_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'downloaded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'skipped'::text])))
CONSTRAINT open_house open_house_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (open_house_key)
CONSTRAINT property property_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (listing_key)
CONSTRAINT rate_budget rate_budget_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (window_kind, window_start)
CONSTRAINT rate_budget rate_budget_window_kind_check: CHECK ((window_kind = ANY (ARRAY['hour'::text, 'day'::text])))
CONSTRAINT room room_listing_key_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (listing_key) REFERENCES <schema>.property(listing_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
CONSTRAINT room room_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (listing_key, room_key)
CONSTRAINT schema_meta schema_meta_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (key)
CONSTRAINT sync_state sync_state_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (resource, originating_system)
CONSTRAINT unit_type unit_type_listing_key_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (listing_key) REFERENCES <schema>.property(listing_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
CONSTRAINT unit_type unit_type_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (listing_key, unit_type_key)
